title: acs state fragment for /acs:code
description: What THIS skill records: the `states` keys it owns and, when it completes in more than one way, its closed `outcome` vocabulary. The envelope is validated centrally by step-state.schema.json; this fragment is why adding a skill is a directory rather than an edit to a central schema (§4.4).

commits.description: Legacy and optional: commits a run made before ADR-0127. /acs:code commits nothing now; /acs:create-pr does.

files.description: Repo-relative paths this run wrote and left uncommitted in the working tree (ADR-0127); /acs:create-pr groups them per plan slice from the implementer reports' `files_changed`.

outcome.description: One way to complete; the leg that did it is recorded on the run's step entry.
